model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the negative log probability scores for mistralv0.2-Base fine-tuned on various specialities. The horizontal axis displays the names of the specialities, including “Cardio”, “Gastro”, “Infect”, “Neuro”, “Obstetrics”, and “Pediatrics”, listed in alphabetical order. The vertical axis represents “Negative log probability per-speciality terms”, with a scale ranging from approximately -27 to -22, marked with tick labels spaced by one unit and displaying negative numerical values. The mistralv0.2-Base model is represented by a blue bar, while the fine-tuned versions on Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics are represented by orange bars.  The height of each bar corresponds to the negative log probability score; the shortest bar, representing the model fine-tuned on “Infect”, has a value of approximately -26.3, while the tallest bar, representing the model fine-tuned on “Neuro”, has a value of approximately -22.1. All bars are presented in their original order and are not visually emphasized.
